request: Three measured cycle-time fixes: (1) stamp phase re-entries so the tdd/integrate auto-loop becomes visible in the timing JSONL; (2) add a scout node before spec in the spec-entry track, with the seed.md amendment it requires; (3) widen the right-size gate window to 8 files / 200 lines.
novelty_evidence: Searched .claude/hooks/lib/timing.mjs, phase_timer.mjs and the 429-file test suite for an attempt/retry/re-entry concept on a phase stamp: none exists. stampFromWorkflow dedups on a bare phase name (const stamped = new Set(existing.map(s => s.phase))), so a phase re-entered by the harness integrate auto-loop (harness/SKILL.md:201, which re-invokes tdd and integrate in-place without touching completed[]) leaves no record. Items 2 and 3 are pattern-copy by contrast: intake-full already declares a scout node, and the right-size thresholds are already parameterised in configFromProject.
track_reason: not required - tdd-quickfix is the leanest track covering the risk; all three changes have an existing test file to extend (tests/phase-timer-timing.test.mjs, tests/rightsize-gate.test.mjs, tests/byte-equivalent-migration.test.mjs). User confirmed the track and confirmed landing all three together.
